post.title: 89% targeted by shopping scams lost money. The red flags
post.ig:
In 2025, 89% of people targeted by online shopping scams lost money (BBB).

Online purchase scams were 28.4% of BBB Scam Tracker reports in 2025; median loss $68.
All reported fraud losses to the FTC: $15.9B in 2025, up from $3.4B in 2020.
FTC red flags: prices far below retail, ads copying real brands, sellers who take only gift cards, wires, payment apps or crypto. Credit cards carry federal dispute rights (generally 60 days from the statement); gift cards and wires are hard to reverse.

Sources: BBB 2025 Scam Tracker Risk Report; FTC Consumer Sentinel; Fair Credit Billing Act.
